Aseprite-compatible, open source

Reads and writes .aseprite files directly. Your existing sprite library works from day one. MIT license — fork it, host it, ship it.

Tilemaps as first-class layers

Paint tiles and sprites in the same project file, same undo stack, same palette. Autotile rules, animated tiles, TMX export — all built in.

AI verbs, not generators

Inbetween, Continue, Extend, Variant, Cleanup — commands that run in canvas with your palette and your layers. You keep the brush. AI handles the toil.

AI verbs

Every verb runs inside the canvas with your project context. Output is always a non-destructive layer you accept, edit, or discard.

Inbetween

animation

Generate intermediate frames between two key frames, palette-locked.

Continue

animation

Predict the next 1–3 frames from the last N, consistent with motion and style.

Extend

sprite

Generate 4-direction or 8-direction views from a single sprite.

Variant

sprite

Palette swaps, equipment overlays, and expression sets as derived layers.

Cleanup

sprite

Snap to palette, remove anti-aliasing, fix pivot drift across frames.

Tile

tilemap

Generate a 47-blob autotile set from 1–3 example tile transitions.

Critique

analysis

Vision-language analysis: pose errors, palette violations, missing frames.

Sketch finishing

sprite

Refine rough silhouettes into finished sprites in your project's style.

Conversational

editing

Natural language driving multi-step editor commands with live preview.
